basis: Offline title/type/format taxonomy; facts override guesses. Category is not rig, format, download or integration proof.
classification_notes: Rules are ordered; heightmaps precede materials, sound precedes animal/weapon words, and material names precede mesh guesses.

steps: Inspect first (operator, root): sudo python3 /data/ai/watoom-code/config/skills/watoom-metahuman/scripts/metahuman_pipeline.py inspect /data/ai/assets/fab/<pack>. It reports each character as 'editable' (a MetaHuman Creator character) or 'assembled', its LODs, grooms and clothing, and verifies the package hash.

To Unreal: 'unpack <pack>' builds a verified <pack>/Content tree; 'copy-to-project <pack> <UE project dir>' copies it into a project and enables MetaHumanCharacter, MetaHumanSDK and RigLogic. Open the project in Unreal 5.6+ with the MetaHuman plugin; editable characters are opened and assembled there.

To Godot: 'export-godot <pack> <Character>' (for example Base_Female) runs two Unreal stages on the Bazzite worker and writes /data/ai/artifacts/metahuman/<pack>/<Character>/godot with GLB meshes (head, body, full body), DNA files, normal maps, a scene and a setup script. Copy that folder to res://metahuman/<Character>/ and instance <Character>.tscn.
Verify in Godot: skeleton count, scale (metres), the head following the body pose, and a visible render. Replace the flat skin_tone with real skin textures if you have them.
pipelines.approval_scope: Explicit per-asset owner approval before any additional Fab download; reuse existing receipts, do not redownload automatically.
pitfalls: Skin base-colour and composited skin maps are generated with a GPU TextureGraph and are NOT produced by the headless worker; the Godot export uses a flat skin tone plus the stored normal maps.
Facial animation is RigLogic-driven (the .dna files); Godot has no RigLogic, so the face is a static neutral pose that follows the body skeleton.
Editable characters need an 8 GiB Unreal job on Bazzite; fewer than 8 GiB free RAM there means the job waits.
Check the MetaHuman licence terms for the target engine before shipping.
pipelines.qualification_scope: Qualified on the owned Ultimate Metahuman Body: Base Adult (editable female) through Godot 4.7 import; other packs and assembled characters are untested.
